newsitem.title: USA: Steinhardt to distribute Sunbeam stock.
newsitem.headline: Steinhardt to distribute Sunbeam stock.

text.p: Steinhardt funds which owned Sunbeam Corp common stock would distribute these shares to their shareholders on a pro-rata basis, Steinhardt said on Wednesday.

Steinhardt decided last year to wind down its positions. The fund group said in a statement it had already distributed a substantial portion of investor capital but that three funds still retained sizeable Sunbeam holdings.
As of the last public filing, the funds -- Steinhardt Partners L.P., Institutional Partners L.P. and S.P. International S.A. -- owned 17.1 million Sunbeam shares, or 20.5 percent of the company.
Steinhardt said the exact number of shares each investor would receive would be based on the closing price of Sunbeam stock on September 19.
Steinhardt said Sunbeam shares appreciated substantially since Albert Dunlap's appointment as company chairman and chief executive officer on July 18.
